title.zh: 卷九十六 列傳第二十六: 耶律仁先 耶律良 蕭韓家奴 蕭德 蕭惟信 蕭樂音奴 耶律敵烈 姚景行 耶律阿思
title.en: Volume 96 Biographies 26: Yelu Renxian, Yelu Liang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao De, Xiao Weixin, Xiao Leyinnu, Yelu Dilie, Yao Jingxing, Yelu Asi
title.raw: 卷九十六 列傳第二十六: 耶律仁先 耶律良 蕭韓家奴 蕭德 蕭惟信 蕭樂音奴 耶律敵烈 姚景行 耶律阿思 Volume 96 Biographies 26: Yelu Renxian, Yelu Liang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao De, Xiao Weixin, Xiao Leyinnu, Yelu Dilie, Yao Jingxing, Yelu Asi

sentences.zh: 耶律仁先

translations.literal: Yelu Renxian
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Renxian

sentences.zh: （撻不也）〉

translations.literal: (Tabuye))
translations.idiomatic: (Tabuye))

sentences.zh: 耶律良蕭韓家奴蕭德蕭惟信蕭樂音奴耶律敵烈姚景行耶律阿思

translations.literal: Yelu Liang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao De, Xiao Weixin, Xiao Leyinnu, Yelu Dilie, Yao Jingxing, Yelu Asi
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Liang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao De, Xiao Weixin, Xiao Leyinnu, Yelu Dilie, Yao Jingxing, and Yelu Asi

sentences.zh: 耶律仁先，字糺鄰，小字查剌，孟父房之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Renxian, style name Qiulin, childhood name Chala, was a descendant of the Mengfu line.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Renxian, whose style name was Qiulin and whose childhood name was Chala, came from the Mengfu line.

sentences.zh: 父瑰引，南府宰相，封燕王。

translations.literal: His father Guiyin was Chancellor of the Southern Office and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Guiyin served as Chancellor of the Southern Office and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 仁先魁偉爽秀，有智略。

translations.literal: Renxian was tall, imposing, and bright in bearing, and possessed strategy and resourcefulness.
translations.idiomatic: Renxian was tall and imposing, with a bright and open bearing, and he possessed both strategy and resourcefulness.

sentences.zh: 重熙三年，補護衛。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongxi, he was appointed to the guard corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongxi, he was appointed to the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 帝與論政，才之。

translations.literal: The emperor discussed government with him and recognized his talent.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor discussed government with him, he recognized Renxian's talent.

sentences.zh: 仁先以不世遇，言無所隱。

translations.literal: Renxian, having received an encounter beyond the ordinary, spoke without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Because Renxian had been granted an extraordinary audience, he spoke without holding anything back.

sentences.zh: 授宿直將軍，累遷殿前副點檢，改鶴剌唐古部節度使，俄召為北面林牙。

translations.literal: He was appointed Night-Duty General, was repeatedly promoted to Deputy Commander of the Palace Front, was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Hela Tanggu Tribe, and soon after was summoned to serve as Northern Chancellor Linya.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Night-Duty General, rose through successive posts to Deputy Commander of the Palace Front, was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Hela Tanggu Tribe, and was soon summoned back to serve as Northern Chancellor Linya.

sentences.zh: 十一年，升北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, he was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court.

sentences.zh: 時宋請增歲幣銀絹以償十縣地產，仁先與劉六符使宋，仍議書「貢」。

translations.literal: At that time Song requested an increase in annual tribute of silver and silk to compensate for the produce of the ten counties, and Renxian went on embassy to Song with Liu Liufu, still insisting that the document use the word "tribute."
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Song court asked to increase the annual tribute of silver and silk to compensate for the produce of the ten counties; Renxian went to Song with Liu Liufu as envoy and still pressed that the treaty use the word "tribute."

sentences.zh: 宋難之。

translations.literal: Song found this difficult to accept.
translations.idiomatic: The Song side resisted.

sentences.zh: 仁先曰：「曩者石晉報德本朝，割地以獻，周人攘而取之，是非利害，灼然可見。

translations.literal: Renxian said: "Formerly the Later Jin repaid our dynasty's kindness by ceding territory as an offering; the Zhou seized it by force. Right and wrong, gain and loss, are plainly visible.
translations.idiomatic: Renxian said: "In the past the Later Jin repaid our dynasty's kindness by ceding territory as an offering, and the Zhou seized it by force. The rights and wrongs, and what was gained or lost, are plainly visible.

sentences.zh: 」宋無辭以對。

translations.literal: " Song had no reply.
translations.idiomatic: " Song had no answer.

sentences.zh: 乃定議增銀、絹十萬兩、匹，仍稱「貢」。

translations.literal: An agreement was then fixed to increase silver and silk by one hundred thousand taels and bolts, while still calling it "tribute."
translations.idiomatic: They then agreed to increase silver and silk by one hundred thousand taels and bolts, while still using the term "tribute."

sentences.zh: 既還，同知南京留守事。

translations.literal: After his return, he served as Co-Administrator of the Southern Capital garrison command.
translations.idiomatic: After he returned, he served as Co-Administrator of the Southern Capital garrison command.

sentences.zh: 十三年，伐夏，留仁先鎮邊。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when the dynasty campaigned against Xia, Renxian was left to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, during the campaign against Xia, Renxian was left to guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 未幾，召為契丹行宮都部署，奏復王子班郎君及諸宮雜役。

translations.literal: Before long he was summoned to be Grand Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace, and memorialized for the restoration of the Prince's Class of Attendant Gentlemen and the miscellaneous palace services.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was summoned to be Grand Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace and memorialized for the restoration of the Prince's Class of Attendant Gentlemen and the miscellaneous palace services.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遷北院大王，奏今兩院戶口殷庶，乞免他部助役，從之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was transferred to Great King of the Northern Court and memorialized that the households of both courts were now numerous and prosperous, requesting exemption from corvée assistance by other tribes; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to Great King of the Northern Court and memorialized that the households of both courts were now numerous and prosperous, asking that they be exempted from corvée assistance by other tribes; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十八年，再舉伐夏，仁先與皇太弟重元為前鋒。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the dynasty again campaigned against Xia, Renxian and the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan served as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the dynasty again campaigned against Xia, Renxian and the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan served as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 蕭惠失利於河南，帝猶欲進兵，仁先力諫，乃止。

translations.literal: Xiao Hui suffered defeat south of the river, yet the emperor still wished to advance; Renxian strongly remonstrated, and the advance was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hui suffered defeat south of the river, yet the emperor still wished to press forward; Renxian remonstrated forcefully, and the advance was halted.

sentences.zh: 後知北院樞密使，遷東京留守。

translations.literal: Later he became Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court and was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Later he became Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court and was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 女直恃險，侵掠不止，仁先乞開山通道以控制之，邊民安業。

translations.literal: The Jurchen relied on difficult terrain and raided without cease; Renxian requested that mountain roads be opened to control them, and the frontier people lived in peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen relied on difficult terrain and raided without cease; Renxian asked that mountain roads be opened to control them, and the frontier people were able to live in peace.

sentences.zh: 封吳王。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，為南院樞密使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he served as Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Court.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qingning, he served as Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Court.

sentences.zh: 以耶律化哥譖，出為南京兵馬副元帥，守太尉，更王隋。

translations.literal: Because of slander by Yelu Huage, he was sent out as Deputy Grand Marshal of armies and horses at the Southern Capital, retained the rank of Grand Guardian, and his princedom was changed to Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Because of slander by Yelu Huage, he was sent out as Deputy Grand Marshal of armies and horses at the Southern Capital, retained the rank of Grand Guardian, and his princedom was changed to Sui.

sentences.zh: 六年，復為北院大王，民歡迎數百里，如見父兄。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he again became Great King of the Northern Court; the people welcomed him for several hundred li as if seeing a father or elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again became Great King of the Northern Court; the people welcomed him for several hundred li as if seeing a father or elder brother.

sentences.zh: 時北、南院樞密官涅魯古、蕭胡睹等忌之，請以仁先為西北路招討使。

translations.literal: At that time the Commissioners of Military Affairs of the Northern and Southern courts, Nielugu and Xiao Hudu, and others envied him and requested that Renxian be made Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Nielugu, Xiao Hudu, and other officials of the Northern and Southern Commissioners of Military Affairs envied him and asked that Renxian be appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 耶律乙辛奏曰：「仁先舊臣，德冠一時，不宜補外。

translations.literal: Yelu Yixin memorialized: "Renxian is an old minister whose virtue surpasses his age; he should not be sent to fill an outer post.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Yixin memorialized: "Renxian is an old minister whose virtue surpasses his age; he should not be sent out to fill an outer post.

sentences.zh: 」復拜南院樞密使，更王許。

translations.literal: " He was again appointed Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Court, and his princedom was changed to Xu.
translations.idiomatic: " He was again appointed Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Court, and his princedom was changed to Xu.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，上獵太子山，耶律良奏重元謀逆，帝召仁先語之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year, when the emperor was hunting at Mount Taizi, Yelu Liang reported that Chongyuan was plotting rebellion; the emperor summoned Renxian and told him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year, while the emperor was hunting at Mount Taizi, Yelu Liang reported that Chongyuan was plotting rebellion; the emperor summoned Renxian and told him.

sentences.zh: 仁先曰：「此曹凶狠，臣固疑之久矣。

translations.literal: Renxian said: "These men are fierce and cruel; your servant has long suspected them.
translations.idiomatic: Renxian said: "These men are fierce and cruel; I have long suspected them.

sentences.zh: 」帝趣仁先捕之。

translations.literal: " The emperor urged Renxian to seize them.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor urged Renxian to seize them.

sentences.zh: 仁先出，且曰：「陛下宜謹為之備！

translations.literal: Renxian went out and also said: "Your Majesty should take strict precautions!
translations.idiomatic: Renxian went out and also said: "Your Majesty should take strict precautions!

sentences.zh: 」未及介馬，重元犯帷宮。

translations.literal: " Before he could saddle his horse, Chongyuan attacked the imperial encampment.
translations.idiomatic: " Before he could saddle his horse, Chongyuan attacked the imperial encampment.

sentences.zh: 帝欲幸北、南院，仁先曰：「陛下若舍扈從而行，賊必躡其後；

translations.literal: The emperor wished to go to the Northern and Southern courts; Renxian said: "If Your Majesty abandons your escort and goes, the rebels will surely follow close behind;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to go to the Northern and Southern courts; Renxian said: "If Your Majesty abandons your escort and goes, the rebels will surely follow close behind;

sentences.zh: 且南、北大王心未可知。

translations.literal: moreover, the hearts of the Great Kings of the Northern and Southern courts are not yet known.
translations.idiomatic: moreover, the hearts of the Great Kings of the Northern and Southern courts are not yet known.

sentences.zh: 」仁先子撻不也曰：「聖意豈可違乎？

translations.literal: " Renxian's son Tabuye said: "How can the sacred will be disobeyed?
translations.idiomatic: " Renxian's son Tabuye said: "How can the sacred will be disobeyed?

sentences.zh: 」仁先怒，擊其首。

translations.literal: " Renxian in anger struck him on the head.
translations.idiomatic: " Renxian in anger struck him on the head.

sentences.zh: 帝悟，悉委仁先以討賊事。

translations.literal: The emperor understood, and entrusted Renxian entirely with the task of suppressing the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor understood, and entrusted Renxian entirely with suppressing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 乃環車為營，拆行馬，作兵仗，率官屬近侍三十餘騎陣柢枑外。

translations.literal: He then ringed the carts to make a camp, dismantled the traveling horses, made weapons, and led more than thirty mounted officials and close attendants to form a battle line outside the barrier of timbers.
translations.idiomatic: He then ringed the carts to make a camp, dismantled the traveling horses, made weapons, and led more than thirty mounted officials and close attendants to form a battle line outside the timber barrier.

sentences.zh: 及交戰，賊眾多降。

translations.literal: When battle was joined, many of the rebels surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: When battle was joined, many of the rebels surrendered.

sentences.zh: 涅魯古中矢墮馬，擒之，重元被傷而退。

translations.literal: Nielugu was struck by an arrow, fell from his horse, and was captured; Chongyuan was wounded and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Nielugu was struck by an arrow, fell from his horse, and was captured; Chongyuan was wounded and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 仁先以五院部蕭塔剌所居最近，亟召之，分遣人集諸軍。

translations.literal: Renxian, because Xiao Tala of the Five-Yuan Division lived nearest, urgently summoned him and sent men in different directions to gather the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xiao Tala of the Five-Yuan Division lived nearest, Renxian urgently summoned him and sent men in different directions to gather the armies.

sentences.zh: 黎明，重元率奚人二千犯行宮，蕭塔剌兵適至。

translations.literal: At dawn, Chongyuan led two thousand Xi men to attack the traveling palace, and Xiao Tala's troops arrived just in time.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn Chongyuan led two thousand Xi men to attack the traveling palace, and Xiao Tala's troops arrived just in time.

sentences.zh: 仁先料賊勢不能久，俟其氣沮攻之。

translations.literal: Renxian judged that the rebel force could not hold long and waited until their spirit flagged before attacking.
translations.idiomatic: Renxian judged that the rebel force could not hold long and waited until their spirit flagged before attacking.

sentences.zh: 乃背營而陣，乘便奮擊，賊眾奔潰，追殺二十餘里，重元與數騎遁去。

translations.literal: He then arrayed his forces with their backs to the camp, struck at an opportune moment with full force, the rebel masses broke and fled, and they were pursued and slaughtered for more than twenty li; Chongyuan escaped with a few horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: He then arrayed his forces with their backs to the camp, struck at an opportune moment with full force, the rebel masses broke and fled, and they were pursued and slaughtered for more than twenty li; Chongyuan escaped with only a few horsemen.

sentences.zh: 帝執仁先手曰：「平亂皆卿之功也。

translations.literal: The emperor took Renxian by the hand and said: "The pacification of the rebellion is entirely your achievement.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took Renxian by the hand and said: "The pacification of this rebellion is entirely your achievement.

sentences.zh: 」加尚父，進封宋王，為北院樞密使，親制文以褒之，詔畫《灤河戰圖》以旌其功。

translations.literal: " He was given the title Imperial Father, advanced to Prince of Song, made Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court; the emperor personally composed a text to praise him, and ordered that the "Battle at the Luan River" be painted to commemorate his merit.
translations.idiomatic: " He was given the title Imperial Father, advanced to Prince of Song, and made Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court; the emperor personally composed a text to praise him and ordered the "Battle at the Luan River" painted to commemorate his merit.

sentences.zh: 撻不也，字胡獨堇。

translations.literal: Tabuye, style name Hudujin.
translations.idiomatic: Tabuye, whose style name was Hudujin.

sentences.zh: 清寧二年，補祗候郎君，累遷永興宮使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingning, he was appointed Attendant Gentleman and was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingning he was appointed Attendant Gentleman and was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.

sentences.zh: 以平重元之亂，遙授忠正軍節度使，賜定亂功臣，同知殿前點檢司事。

translations.literal: For pacifying Chongyuan's rebellion, he was given in absentia the post of Military Commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army, granted the title Merit Subject Who Settled the Rebellion, and made Co-Commander of the Palace Front Inspection Office.
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying Chongyuan's rebellion he was given in absentia the post of Military Commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army, granted the title Merit Subject Who Settled the Rebellion, and made Co-Commander of the Palace Front Inspection Office.

sentences.zh: 歷高陽、臨海二軍節度使、左皮室詳穩。

translations.literal: He served successively as Military Commissioner of the Gaoyang and Linhai armies and as Xiangwen of the Left Pishi.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Military Commissioner of the Gaoyang and Linhai armies and as Xiangwen of the Left Pishi.

sentences.zh: 大康六年，授西北路招討使，率諸部酋長入朝，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Dakang, he was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit, led the chieftains of the various tribes to court, and was additionally made Vice Minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Dakang he was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit, led the chieftains of the various tribes to court, and was additionally made Vice Minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 自蕭敵祿為招討之後，朝廷務姑息，多擇柔願者用之，諸部漸至跋扈。

translations.literal: After Xiao Dilu served as pacification commissioner, the court pursued a policy of indulgence and often chose the mild and compliant for the post, and the tribes gradually became arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiao Dilu served as pacification commissioner, the court pursued a policy of indulgence and often chose the mild and compliant for the post, and the tribes gradually became arrogant.

sentences.zh: 撻不也含容尤甚，邊防益廢，尋改西南面招討使。

translations.literal: Tabuye was especially indulgent, frontier defense grew all the more neglected, and he was soon transferred to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tabuye was especially indulgent, frontier defense grew all the more neglected, and he was soon transferred to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 阻卜酋長磨古斯來侵，西北路招討使何魯掃古戰不利，詔撻不也代之。

translations.literal: The Zubu chieftain Mogusi came to raid; the Northwest Pacification Commissioner Helu Saogu fought poorly, and an edict ordered Tabuye to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: The Zubu chieftain Mogusi came to raid; the Northwest Pacification Commissioner Helu Saogu fought poorly, and an edict ordered Tabuye to replace him.

sentences.zh: 磨古斯之為酋長，由撻不也所薦，至是遣人誘致之。

translations.literal: Mogusi had become chieftain on Tabuye's recommendation; now he sent men to lure him out.
translations.idiomatic: Mogusi had become chieftain on Tabuye's recommendation; now he sent men to lure him out.

sentences.zh: 磨古斯紿降，撻不也逆於鎮州西南沙磧間，禁士卒無得妄動。

translations.literal: Mogusi pretended to surrender; Tabuye went out to meet him in the sandy wastes southwest of Zhenzhou and forbade the soldiers to act rashly.
translations.idiomatic: Mogusi pretended to surrender; Tabuye went out to meet him in the sandy wastes southwest of Zhenzhou and forbade the soldiers to act rashly.

sentences.zh: 敵至，裨將耶律綰斯、徐烈見其勢銳，不及戰而走，遂被害，年五十八。

translations.literal: When the enemy arrived, the deputy generals Yelu Wansi and Xu Lie saw that their force was fierce and fled without fighting; Tabuye was then killed, at age fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy arrived, the deputy generals Yelu Wansi and Xu Lie saw that their force was fierce and fled without fighting; Tabuye was then killed, at age fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈兼侍中，謚曰貞憫。

translations.literal: He was posthumously given the additional title Vice Minister of the Secretariat, with posthumous name Zhenmin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously given the additional title Vice Minister of the Secretariat, with posthumous name Zhenmin.

sentences.zh: 撻不也少謹願，後為族嫠婦所惑，出其妻，終以無子。

translations.literal: In his youth Tabuye was cautious and compliant, but later he was beguiled by a widowed woman of his clan, drove out his wife, and in the end had no sons.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth Tabuye was cautious and compliant, but later he was beguiled by a widowed woman of his clan, drove out his wife, and in the end had no sons.

sentences.zh: 人以此譏之。

translations.literal: People mocked him for this.
translations.idiomatic: People mocked him for this.

sentences.zh: 耶律良，字習撚，小字蘇，著帳郎君之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Liang, style name Xinian, childhood name Su, was a descendant of the Registered-Account Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Liang, whose style name was Xinian and whose childhood name was Su, was a descendant of the Registered-Account Attendant Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 生於乾州，讀書醫巫閭山。

translations.literal: Born in Qianzhou, he studied on Mount Yiwulü.
translations.idiomatic: Born in Qianzhou, he studied on Mount Yiwulü.

sentences.zh: 學既博，將入南山肄業，友人止之曰：」爾無仆禦，驅馳千里，縱聞見過人，年亦垂暮。

translations.literal: When his learning was already broad, he was about to enter the southern mountains to pursue further study; a friend stopped him, saying: "You have no servants or escort; to gallop a thousand li—even if your knowledge surpasses others, your years are already near their end.
translations.idiomatic: When his learning was already broad, he was about to enter the southern mountains for further study; a friend stopped him, saying: "You have no servants or escort; to gallop a thousand li—even if your knowledge surpasses others, your years are already near their end.

sentences.zh: 今若即仕，已有餘地。

translations.literal: If you take office now, you already have room to advance.
translations.idiomatic: If you take office now, you already have room to advance.

sentences.zh: 」良曰：「窮通命也，非爾所知。

translations.literal: " Liang said: "Fortune and obscurity are a matter of fate; that is not for you to know.
translations.idiomatic: " Liang said: "Fortune and obscurity are a matter of fate; that is not for you to know.

sentences.zh: 」不聽，留數年而歸。

translations.literal: " He would not listen, stayed several years, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: " He would not listen, stayed several years, and returned.

sentences.zh: 重熙中，補寢殿小底，尋為燕趙國王近侍。

translations.literal: During Chongxi, he was appointed Junior Attendant of the Sleeping Quarters and soon became a close attendant of the Prince of Yan and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongxi he was appointed Junior Attendant of the Sleeping Quarters and soon became a close attendant of the Prince of Yan and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 以家貧，詔乘廄馬。

translations.literal: Because his family was poor, an edict allowed him to ride stable horses.
translations.idiomatic: Because his family was poor, an edict allowed him to ride stable horses.

sentences.zh: 遷修起居註。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Compiler of the Imperial Diary.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Compiler of the Imperial Diary.

sentences.zh: 會獵秋山，良進《秋遊賦》，上嘉之。

translations.literal: When the emperor hunted at Autumn Mountain, Liang presented the "Autumn Excursion Rhapsody," and the emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor hunted at Autumn Mountain, Liang presented the "Autumn Excursion Rhapsody," and the emperor praised it.

sentences.zh: 清寧中，上幸鴨子河，作《捕魚賦》。

translations.literal: During Qingning, when the emperor visited Duck River, he composed the "Fishing Rhapsody."
translations.idiomatic: During Qingning, when the emperor visited Duck River, he composed the "Fishing Rhapsody."

sentences.zh: 由是寵遇稍隆，遷知制誥，兼知部署司事。

translations.literal: From this his favor gradually increased; he was promoted to Drafter of Edicts and concurrently Administrator of the Deployment Office.
translations.idiomatic: From this his favor gradually increased; he was promoted to Drafter of Edicts and concurrently Administrator of the Deployment Office.

sentences.zh: 奏請編御製詩文，目曰《清寧集》；

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that the emperor's compositions be compiled under the title "Qingning Collection";
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting that the emperor's compositions be compiled under the title "Qingning Collection";

sentences.zh: 上命良詩為《慶會集》，親制其序。

translations.literal: the emperor ordered Liang to compose poems for the "Celebration Assembly Collection" and personally wrote its preface.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor ordered Liang to compose poems for the "Celebration Assembly Collection" and personally wrote its preface.

sentences.zh: 頃之，為敦睦宮使，兼權知皇太后宮諸局事。

translations.literal: Before long he became Commissioner of the Dunmu Palace and concurrently Acting Administrator of the various bureaus of the Empress Dowager's Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he became Commissioner of the Dunmu Palace and concurrently Acting Administrator of the various bureaus of the Empress Dowager's Palace.

sentences.zh: 良聞重元與子涅魯古謀亂，以帝篤於親愛，不敢遽奏，密言於皇太后。

translations.literal: Liang heard that Chongyuan and his son Nielugu were plotting rebellion; because the emperor was deeply devoted to kinship, he did not dare report it at once and spoke secretly to the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Liang heard that Chongyuan and his son Nielugu were plotting rebellion; because the emperor was deeply devoted to kinship, he did not dare report it at once and spoke secretly to the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 太皇托疾，召帝白其事。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager feigned illness and summoned the emperor to inform him.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager feigned illness and summoned the emperor to inform him.

sentences.zh: 帝謂良曰：「汝欲間我骨肉耶？

translations.literal: The emperor said to Liang: "Do you wish to estrange me from my own flesh and blood?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to Liang: "Do you wish to estrange me from my own flesh and blood?

sentences.zh: 」良奏曰：「臣若妄言，甘伏斧锧。

translations.literal: " Liang memorialized: "If your servant speaks falsely, I am willing to submit to the axe.
translations.idiomatic: " Liang memorialized: "If I speak falsely, I am willing to submit to the axe.

sentences.zh: 陛下不早備，恐墮賊計。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty does not prepare early, I fear you will fall into the rebels' plot.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty does not prepare early, I fear you will fall into the rebels' plot.

sentences.zh: 如召涅魯古不來，可卜其事。

translations.literal: If Nielugu is summoned and does not come, the matter can be tested.
translations.idiomatic: If Nielugu is summoned and does not come, the matter can be tested.

sentences.zh: 」帝從其言。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 使者及門，涅魯古意欲害之，羈於帳下。

translations.literal: When the envoy reached the gate, Nielugu intended to kill him and detained him in the tent.
translations.idiomatic: When the envoy reached the gate, Nielugu intended to kill him and detained him in the tent.

sentences.zh: 使者以佩刀斷帟而出，馳至行宮，以狀聞。

translations.literal: The envoy cut the tent ropes with his belt knife and fled out, galloped to the traveling palace, and reported the situation.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy cut the tent ropes with his belt knife and fled out, galloped to the traveling palace, and reported the situation.

sentences.zh: 帝始信。

translations.literal: Only then did the emperor believe it.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did the emperor believe it.

sentences.zh: 亂平，以功遷漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: When the rebellion was pacified, he was transferred for merit to Grand Commander of the Han Chinese Traveling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebellion was pacified, he was transferred for merit to Grand Commander of the Han Chinese Traveling Palace.

sentences.zh: 咸雍初，同知南院樞密使事，為惕隱，出知中京留守事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianyong, he served as Co-Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Court, was made Texun, and went out as Administrator of the Central Capital garrison command.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianyong he served as Co-Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Court, was made Texun, and went out as Administrator of the Central Capital garrison command.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒，帝嗟悼，遣重臣賻祭，給葬具，追封遼西郡王，謚曰忠成。

translations.literal: Before long he died; the emperor sighed in grief, sent a high minister with funeral gifts, provided burial goods, and posthumously enfeoffed him as Prince of Liaoxi with posthumous name Zhongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died; the emperor sighed in grief, sent a high minister with funeral gifts, provided burial goods, and posthumously enfeoffed him as Prince of Liaoxi with posthumous name Zhongcheng.

sentences.zh: 蕭韓家奴，字括寧，奚長渤魯恩之後。

translations.literal: Xiao Hanjianu, style name Kuoning, was a descendant of the Xi chieftain Boluen.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hanjianu, whose style name was Kuoning, was a descendant of the Xi chieftain Boluen.

sentences.zh: 性孝友。

translations.literal: His nature was filial and friendly.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was filial and friendly.

sentences.zh: 太平中，補祗候郎君，累遷敦睦宮使。

translations.literal: During Taiping, he was appointed Attendant Gentleman and was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Dunmu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: During Taiping he was appointed Attendant Gentleman and was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Dunmu Palace.

sentences.zh: 伐夏，為左翼都監，遷北面林牙。

translations.literal: In the campaign against Xia, he served as Left Vanguard Commander and was transferred to Northern Chancellor Linya.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Xia he served as Left Vanguard Commander and was transferred to Northern Chancellor Linya.

sentences.zh: 俄為南院副部署，賜玉帶，改奚六部大王，治有聲。

translations.literal: Soon after he became Deputy Commander of the Southern Court, was granted a jade belt, was transferred to Great King of the Six Xi Tribes, and his governance won renown.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he became Deputy Commander of the Southern Court, was granted a jade belt, was transferred to Great King of the Six Xi Tribes, and his governance won renown.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，封韓國公，歷南京統軍使、北院宣徽使，封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingning, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Han, served successively as Commander of armies at the Southern Capital and Commissioner of the Northern Court Privy Seal, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qingning he was enfeoffed as Duke of Han, served in turn as Commander of armies at the Southern Capital and Commissioner of the Northern Court Privy Seal, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling.

sentences.zh: 九年，上獵太子山，聞重元亂，馳詣行在。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when the emperor was hunting at Mount Taizi, he heard of Chongyuan's rebellion and galloped to the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when the emperor was hunting at Mount Taizi, he heard of Chongyuan's rebellion and galloped to the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 帝倉卒欲避於北、南大王院，與耶律仁先執轡固諫，乃止。

translations.literal: The emperor in haste wished to flee to the courts of the Northern and Southern Great Kings; together with Yelu Renxian he took the reins and firmly remonstrated, and the emperor stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in haste wished to flee to the courts of the Northern and Southern Great Kings; he and Yelu Renxian took the reins and remonstrated firmly, and only then did he stop.

sentences.zh: 明旦，重元復誘奚獵夫來。

translations.literal: At dawn the next day, Chongyuan again lured Xi hunters to come.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the next day Chongyuan again lured Xi hunters to come.

sentences.zh: 韓家奴獨出諭之曰：「汝曹去順效逆，徒取族滅。

translations.literal: Hanjianu went out alone and instructed them, saying: "You abandon obedience and follow rebellion, and will only bring extermination upon your clans.
translations.idiomatic: Hanjianu went out alone and addressed them: "You abandon obedience and follow rebellion, and will only bring extermination upon your clans.

sentences.zh: 何若悔過，轉禍為福！

translations.literal: Why not repent and turn misfortune into blessing!
translations.idiomatic: Why not repent and turn misfortune into blessing!

sentences.zh: 」獵夫投仗首服。

translations.literal: " The hunters cast down their weapons and submitted with bowed heads.
translations.idiomatic: " The hunters cast down their weapons and submitted with bowed heads.

sentences.zh: 以功遷殿前都點檢，封荊王，賜資忠保義奉國竭貞平亂功臣。

translations.literal: For his merit he was transferred to Commander of the Palace Front, enfeoffed as Prince of Jing, and granted the title Merit Subject Who Devoted Loyalty, Preserved Righteousness, Served the State, Exhausted Integrity, and Pacified Rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was transferred to Commander of the Palace Front, enfeoffed as Prince of Jing, and granted the title Merit Subject Who Devoted Loyalty, Preserved Righteousness, Served the State, Exhausted Integrity, and Pacified Rebellion.

sentences.zh: 咸雍二年，遷西南面招討使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianyong, he was transferred to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianyong he was transferred to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 大康初，徙王吳，賜白海東青鶻。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dakang, his princedom was changed to Wu, and he was granted a white sea dongqing hawk.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dakang his princedom was changed to Wu, and he was granted a white sea dongqing hawk.

sentences.zh: 皇太子為乙辛誣構，幽於上京。

translations.literal: The Crown Prince was framed by Yixin and confined at the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince was framed by Yixin and confined at the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 韓家奴上書力言其冤，不報。

translations.literal: Hanjianu memorialized forcefully to declare his innocence, but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: Hanjianu memorialized forcefully to declare his innocence, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 四年，復為西南面招討使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he again became Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he again became Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 例削一字王爵，改王蘭陵，薨。

translations.literal: By precedent one character was removed from his princely title; his princedom was changed to Lanling, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent one character was removed from his princedom; his princedom was changed to Lanling, and he died.

sentences.zh: 子楊九，終右祗候郎君班詳穩，贈同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: His son Yangjiu ended as Xiangwen of the Right Attendant Gentleman Class and was posthumously given the title Co-Grand Councilor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yangjiu ended as Xiangwen of the Right Attendant Gentleman Class and was posthumously given the title Co-Grand Councilor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 蕭惟信，字耶寧，楮特部人。

translations.literal: Xiao Weixin, style name Yening, was a man of the Zhute Tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Weixin, whose style name was Yening, was a man of the Zhute Tribe.

sentences.zh: 五世祖霞賴，南府宰相。

translations.literal: His fifth-generation ancestor Xialai was Chancellor of the Southern Office.
translations.idiomatic: His fifth-generation ancestor Xialai was Chancellor of the Southern Office.

sentences.zh: 曾祖烏古，中書令。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Wugu was Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Wugu was Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 祖阿古只，知平州。

translations.literal: His grandfather Aguzhi was Administrator of Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Aguzhi was Administrator of Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 父高八，多智數，博覽古今。

translations.literal: His father Gaoba was full of stratagems and broadly read in ancient and modern matters.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gaoba was full of stratagems and had read broadly in ancient and modern learning.

sentences.zh: 開泰初，為北院承旨，稍遷右夷離畢，以幹敏稱，拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyuan, he served as Northern Court Attendant, was gradually promoted to Right Yilibi, was praised for competence and keenness, and was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Office.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaiyuan he served as Northern Court Attendant, was gradually promoted to Right Yilibi, was praised for competence and keenness, and was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Office.

sentences.zh: 累遷倒塌嶺節度使，知興中府，復為右夷離畢。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Military Commissioner of the Daodaoling Circuit, Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture, and again Right Yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Military Commissioner of the Daodaoling Circuit, Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture, and again Right Yilibi.

sentences.zh: 陵青誘眾作亂，事覺，高八按之，止誅首惡，餘並釋之。

translations.literal: Lingqing incited the masses to rebel; when the matter was discovered, Gaoba investigated it, executed only the ringleaders, and released the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Lingqing incited the masses to rebel; when the matter was discovered, Gaoba investigated it, executed only the ringleaders, and released the rest.

sentences.zh: 歸奏，稱旨。

translations.literal: On his return he memorialized, and it pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he memorialized, and it pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 惟信資沈毅，篤誌於學，能辨論。

translations.literal: Weixin was deep and resolute in nature, devoted in will to learning, and able in debate.
translations.idiomatic: Weixin was deep and resolute in nature, devoted in will to learning, and able in debate.

sentences.zh: 重熙初始仕，累遷左右丞。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongxi he first took office and was repeatedly promoted to Left and Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongxi he first took office and was repeatedly promoted to Left and Right Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 十五年，徙燕趙國王傅，帝諭之曰：「燕趙左右多面諛，不聞忠言，浸以成性。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was transferred to Tutor of the Prince of Yan and Zhao; the emperor instructed him: "Around the Prince of Yan and Zhao there are many who flatter to his face and do not speak loyal words, and this has gradually become his nature.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Tutor of the Prince of Yan and Zhao; the emperor instructed him: "Around the Prince of Yan and Zhao there are many who flatter to his face and do not speak loyal words, and this has gradually become his nature.

sentences.zh: 汝當以道規誨，使知君父之義。

translations.literal: You should instruct him with the Way and make him understand the meaning of ruler and father.
translations.idiomatic: You should instruct him with the Way and make him understand the meaning of ruler and father.

sentences.zh: 有不可處王邸者，以名聞。

translations.literal: If there are matters in the prince's residence that cannot be tolerated, report them by name.
translations.idiomatic: If there are matters in the prince's residence that cannot be tolerated, report them by name.

sentences.zh: 」惟信輔導以禮。

translations.literal: " Weixin guided and instructed him with ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: " Weixin guided and instructed him with ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遷北院樞密副使，坐事免官。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court and was dismissed from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court and was dismissed from office for an offense.

sentences.zh: 尋復職，兼北面林牙。

translations.literal: Before long he was restored to office and concurrently served as Northern Chancellor Linya.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was restored to office and concurrently served as Northern Chancellor Linya.

sentences.zh: 清寧九年，重元作亂，犯灤河行宮，惟信從耶律仁先破之，賜竭忠定亂功臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qingning, Chongyuan rebelled and attacked the traveling palace at the Luan River; Weixin followed Yelu Renxian in defeating him and was granted the title Merit Subject Who Exhausted Loyalty and Settled Rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Qingning Chongyuan rebelled and attacked the traveling palace at the Luan River; Weixin followed Yelu Renxian in defeating him and was granted the title Merit Subject Who Exhausted Loyalty and Settled Rebellion.

sentences.zh: 歷南京留守、左右夷離畢，復為北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: He served successively as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital and Left and Right Yilibi, and again became Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital and Left and Right Yilibi, and again became Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Northern Court.

sentences.zh: 大康中，以老乞骸骨，不聽。

translations.literal: During Dakang, because of old age he requested to retire, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: During Dakang, because of old age he requested to retire, but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 樞密使耶律乙辛譖廢太子，中外知其冤，無敢言者，惟信數廷爭，不得復。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelu Yixin slandered and deposed the Crown Prince; inside and outside the court knew his innocence, but none dared speak; Weixin repeatedly argued in court and could not have him restored.
translations.idiomatic: The Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelu Yixin slandered and deposed the Crown Prince; inside and outside the court knew his innocence, but none dared speak; Weixin repeatedly argued in court and could not have him restored.

sentences.zh: 告老，加守司徒，卒。

translations.literal: He reported old age, was given the additional rank of Grand Guardian, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He reported old age, was given the additional rank of Grand Guardian, and died.

sentences.zh: 蕭樂音奴，字婆丹，奚六部敞穩突呂不六世孫。

translations.literal: Xiao Leyinnu, style name Podan, was a sixth-generation descendant of the Xi Six Tribes Xiangwen Tulubu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Leyinnu, whose style name was Podan, was a sixth-generation descendant of the Xi Six Tribes Xiangwen Tulubu.

sentences.zh: 父拔剌，三歲居父母喪，毀瘠過甚，養於家奴奚列阿不。

translations.literal: His father Bala, at age three while in mourning for his parents, became emaciated beyond measure and was raised by the household slave Xi Lieabu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bala, at age three while in mourning for his parents, became emaciated beyond measure and was raised by the household slave Xi Lieabu.

sentences.zh: 重熙初，興宗獵奚山，過拔剌所居，奚列阿不言於近臣，拔剌得見上。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongxi, Emperor Xingzong hunted at Mount Xi; passing Bala's dwelling, Xi Lieabu did not inform the close attendants, yet Bala was able to see the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongxi Emperor Xingzong hunted at Mount Xi; passing Bala's dwelling, Xi Lieabu did not inform the close attendants, yet Bala was able to see the emperor.

sentences.zh: 年甫十歲，氣象如成人。

translations.literal: He was only ten years old, yet his bearing was like that of an adult.
translations.idiomatic: He was only ten years old, yet his bearing was like that of an adult.

sentences.zh: 帝悅之，錫賚甚厚。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased with him and bestowed gifts in great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased with him and bestowed gifts in great abundance.

sentences.zh: 既長，有遠誌，不樂仕進，隱於奚王嶺之插合谷。

translations.literal: When he grew up, he had far-reaching ambition and did not delight in pursuing office; he hid himself in Chahegu on Mount Xi Prince's Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: When he grew up, he had far-reaching ambition and did not delight in pursuing office; he hid himself in Chahegu on Mount Xi Prince's Ridge.

sentences.zh: 上以其名家，又有時譽，就拜舍利軍詳穩。

translations.literal: Because his family was eminent and he also had reputation in his time, he was appointed Xiangwen of the Sheli Army.
translations.idiomatic: Because his family was eminent and he also had reputation in his time, he was appointed Xiangwen of the Sheli Army.

sentences.zh: 樂音奴貌偉言辨，通遼、漢文字，善騎射擊鞠，所交皆一時名士。

translations.literal: Leyinnu was imposing in appearance and eloquent in speech, mastered Khitan and Chinese writing, was skilled at riding, archery, and cuju, and those he associated with were all celebrated men of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Leyinnu was imposing in appearance and eloquent in speech, mastered Khitan and Chinese writing, was skilled at riding, archery, and cuju, and those he associated with were all celebrated men of the age.

sentences.zh: 年四十，始為護衛。

translations.literal: At age forty he first became a guard.
translations.idiomatic: At age forty he first became a guard.

sentences.zh: 平重元之亂，以功遷護衛太保，改本部南克，俄為旗鼓拽剌詳穩。

translations.literal: For pacifying Chongyuan's rebellion, he was transferred for merit to Grand Guardian of the Guard, was changed to Southern Ke of his tribe, and soon became Xiangwen of the Banner-and-Drum Zhuala Detachment.
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying Chongyuan's rebellion he was transferred for merit to Grand Guardian of the Guard, was changed to Southern Ke of his tribe, and soon became Xiangwen of the Banner-and-Drum Zhuala Detachment.

sentences.zh: 監障海東青鶻，獲白花者十三，賜榾柮犀並玉吐鶻。

translations.literal: He supervised the barrier sea dongqing hawks and obtained thirteen white birds; he was granted catalpa wood, rhinoceros horn, and jade spit-hawks.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised the barrier sea dongqing hawks and obtained thirteen white birds; he was granted catalpa wood, rhinoceros horn, and jade spit-hawks.

sentences.zh: 拜五蕃部節度使，卒。

translations.literal: He was appointed Military Commissioner of the Five-Fan Tribes and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Military Commissioner of the Five-Fan Tribes and died.

sentences.zh: 子陽阿，有傳。

translations.literal: His son Yang'a has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yang'a has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 耶律敵烈，字撒懶，采訪使吼五世孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Dilie, style name Salan, was a fifth-generation descendant of the Investigation Commissioner Hou.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Dilie, whose style name was Salan, was a fifth-generation descendant of the Investigation Commissioner Hou.

sentences.zh: 寬厚好學，工文詞。

translations.literal: He was generous and fond of learning, and skilled in literary composition.
translations.idiomatic: He was generous and fond of learning, and skilled in literary composition.

sentences.zh: 重熙末，補牌印郎君，兼知起居註。

translations.literal: At the end of Chongxi, he was appointed Badge-and-Seal Attendant Gentleman and concurrently Compiler of the Imperial Diary.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Chongxi he was appointed Badge-and-Seal Attendant Gentleman and concurrently Compiler of the Imperial Diary.

sentences.zh: 清寧元年，稍遷同知永州事，禁盜有功，改北面林牙承旨。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingning, he was gradually promoted to Co-Administrator of Yongzhou, had merit in prohibiting theft, and was changed to Northern Chancellor Linya Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingning he was gradually promoted to Co-Administrator of Yongzhou, had merit in prohibiting theft, and was changed to Northern Chancellor Linya Attendant.

sentences.zh: 九年，重元作亂，敵烈赴援，力戰平之，遙授臨海軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when Chongyuan rebelled, Dilie rushed to aid, fought fiercely and pacified the rebellion, and was given in absentia the post of Military Commissioner of the Linhai Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when Chongyuan rebelled, Dilie rushed to aid, fought fiercely and pacified the rebellion, and was given in absentia the post of Military Commissioner of the Linhai Army.

sentences.zh: 十年，徙武安州觀察使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he was transferred to Observer of Wu'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to Observer of Wu'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 咸雍五年，累遷長寧宮使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianyong, he was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Changning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xianyong he was repeatedly promoted to Commissioner of the Changning Palace.

sentences.zh: 撿括戶部司乾州錢帛逋負，立出納經畫法，公私便之。

translations.literal: He investigated arrears in money and silk owed to the Household Department Office at Qianzhou, established methods for receipts and disbursements and planning, and both public and private affairs were facilitated.
translations.idiomatic: He investigated arrears in money and silk owed to the Household Department Office at Qianzhou, established methods for receipts, disbursements, and planning, and both public and private affairs were facilitated.

sentences.zh: 大康四年，為南院大王。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dakang, he became Great King of the Southern Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dakang he became Great King of the Southern Court.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，部民請留，同知南京留守事。

translations.literal: When his term ended, the people of his tribe asked that he remain; he served as Co-Administrator of the Southern Capital garrison command.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, the people of his tribe asked that he remain; he served as Co-Administrator of the Southern Capital garrison command.

sentences.zh: 有疾，上命乘傳赴闕，遣太醫視之。

translations.literal: When he fell ill, the emperor ordered that he ride post-horses to court and sent the imperial physician to examine him.
translations.idiomatic: When he fell ill, the emperor ordered that he ride post-horses to court and sent the imperial physician to examine him.

sentences.zh: 遷上京留守。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 大安中，改塌母城節度使。

translations.literal: During Da'an, he was changed to Military Commissioner of Tamu City.
translations.idiomatic: During Da'an he was changed to Military Commissioner of Tamu City.

sentences.zh: 以疾致仕，加兼侍中，賜一品俸。

translations.literal: Because of illness he retired from office, was given the additional title Vice Minister of the Secretariat, and granted first-rank salary.
translations.idiomatic: Because of illness he retired from office, was given the additional title Vice Minister of the Secretariat, and granted first-rank salary.

sentences.zh: 八年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth year.

sentences.zh: 姚景行，始名景禧。

translations.literal: Yao Jingxing, original name Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Jingxing, whose original name was Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 祖漢英，本周將，應歷初來聘，用敵國禮，帝怒，留之，隸漢人宮分。

translations.literal: His grandfather Hanying was a general of Later Zhou; at the beginning of Yingli he came on embassy, was received with the rites due an enemy state, and the emperor in anger detained him and assigned him to the Han Chinese palace division.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Hanying was a general of Later Zhou; at the beginning of Yingli he came on embassy, was received with the rites due an enemy state, and the emperor in anger detained him and assigned him to the Han Chinese palace division.

sentences.zh: 及景行既貴，始出籍，貫興中縣。

translations.literal: When Jingxing became eminent, he was first removed from the register and was enrolled in Xingzhong County.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingxing became eminent, he was first removed from the register and was enrolled in Xingzhong County.

sentences.zh: 景行博學。

translations.literal: Jingxing was broadly learned.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxing was broadly learned.

sentences.zh: 重熙五年，擢進士乙科，為將作監，改燕趙國王教授。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongxi, he was selected in the second rank of the jinshi examination, served as Director of Palace Construction, and was changed to Instructor to the Prince of Yan and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chongxi he was selected in the second rank of the jinshi examination, served as Director of Palace Construction, and was changed to Instructor to the Prince of Yan and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 不數年，至翰林學士，樞密副使，參知政事。

translations.literal: Within a few years he reached Academician of the Hanlin, Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs, and Participant in Government.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years he reached Academician of the Hanlin, Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs, and Participant in Government.

sentences.zh: 性敦厚廉直，人望歸之。

translations.literal: His nature was sincere, thick, honest, and upright, and public esteem turned to him.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was sincere, thick, honest, and upright, and public esteem turned to him.

sentences.zh: 道宗即位，多被顧問，為北府宰相。

translations.literal: When Emperor Daozong took the throne, Jingxing was often consulted and became Chancellor of the Northern Office.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Daozong took the throne, Jingxing was often consulted and became Chancellor of the Northern Office.

sentences.zh: 九年秋，告歸，道聞重元亂，收集行旅，得三百餘騎勤王。

translations.literal: In the ninth autumn he requested leave to return home; on the road he heard of Chongyuan's rebellion, gathered travelers, and obtained more than three hundred mounted men to serve the throne in urgency.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth autumn he requested leave to return home; on the road he heard of Chongyuan's rebellion, gathered travelers, and obtained more than three hundred mounted men to serve the throne in urgency.

sentences.zh: 比至，賊已平。

translations.literal: By the time he arrived, the rebels had already been pacified.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he arrived, the rebels had already been pacified.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其忠，賜以逆人財產。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his loyalty and granted him the property of the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his loyalty and granted him the property of the rebels.

sentences.zh: 咸雍元年，出為武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianyong, he went out as Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianyong he went out as Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 明年，驛召拜南院樞密使。

translations.literal: The next year he was summoned by post relay and appointed Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Court.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was summoned by post relay and appointed Commissioner of Military Affairs of the Southern Court.

sentences.zh: 上從容問治道，引入內殿，出御書及太子書示之，賜什器車仗。

translations.literal: The emperor at leisure asked about the way of governance, brought him into the inner hall, produced imperial writings and the Crown Prince's writings to show him, and granted utensils, carriages, and escorts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at leisure asked about the way of governance, brought him into the inner hall, produced imperial writings and the Crown Prince's writings to show him, and granted utensils, carriages, and escorts.

sentences.zh: 帝有意伐宋，召景行問曰：「宋人好生邊事，如何？

translations.literal: The emperor intended to campaign against Song and summoned Jingxing to ask: "The Song people are fond of stirring up border affairs; what of it?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor intended to campaign against Song and summoned Jingxing to ask: "The Song people are fond of stirring up border affairs; what of it?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「自聖宗皇帝以威德懷遠，宋修職貢，迨今幾六十年。

translations.literal: " He replied: "Since Emperor Shengzong with authority and virtue cherished those afar, Song has presented tribute and duty, down to the present for nearly sixty years.
translations.idiomatic: " He replied: "Since Emperor Shengzong with authority and virtue cherished those afar, Song has presented tribute and duty, down to the present for nearly sixty years.

sentences.zh: 若以細故用兵，恐違先帝成約。

translations.literal: If because of a small matter troops are used, I fear this will violate the former emperor's settled agreement.
translations.idiomatic: If because of a small matter troops are used, I fear this will violate the former emperor's settled agreement.

sentences.zh: 」上然其言而止。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his words and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved his words and stopped.

sentences.zh: 致仕，不逾月復舊職。

translations.literal: He retired from office, but within a month was restored to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office, but within a month was restored to his former post.

sentences.zh: 丁家艱，起復，兼中書令。

translations.literal: When his household mourned, he was recalled from mourning, and concurrently made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When his household mourned, he was recalled from mourning and concurrently made Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 上問古今儒士優劣，占對稱旨，知興中府，改朔方軍節度使。

translations.literal: The emperor asked about the relative merits of Confucian scholars ancient and modern; his reply pleased the emperor, and he was made Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture and transferred to Military Commissioner of the Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked about the relative merits of Confucian scholars ancient and modern; his reply pleased the emperor, and he was made Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture and transferred to Military Commissioner of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 大康初，徙鎮遼興。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dakang, he was transferred to garrison Liaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dakang he was transferred to garrison Liaoxing.

sentences.zh: 以上京多滯獄，命為留守，不數月，以獄空聞。

translations.literal: Because there were many delayed cases at the Supreme Capital, he was appointed Garrison Commander; within a few months it was reported that the prisons were empty.
translations.idiomatic: Because there were many delayed cases at the Supreme Capital, he was appointed Garrison Commander; within a few months it was reported that the prisons were empty.

sentences.zh: 累乞致政，不從。

translations.literal: He repeatedly begged to retire from government, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly begged to retire from government, but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 復請，許之，加守太師。

translations.literal: He requested again and was permitted; he was given the additional rank of Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: He requested again and was permitted; he was given the additional rank of Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 卒，遣使吊祭，追封柳城郡王，謚文憲。

translations.literal: He died; an envoy was sent to offer condolences, and he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liucheng with posthumous name Wenxian.
translations.idiomatic: He died; an envoy was sent to offer condolences, and he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liucheng with posthumous name Wenxian.

sentences.zh: 壽隆五年，詔為立祠。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shoulong, an edict ordered that a shrine be established for him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shoulong an edict ordered that a shrine be established for him.

sentences.zh: 論曰：灤河之變，重元擁兵行幄，微仁先等，道宗其危乎！

translations.literal: The appraisal says: At the Luan River crisis, Chongyuan held troops at the imperial encampment; without Renxian and the others, would Emperor Daozong not have been in peril!
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: At the Luan River crisis Chongyuan held troops at the imperial encampment; without Renxian and the others, would Emperor Daozong not have been in peril!

sentences.zh: 當其止幸北、南院，召塔剌兵以靖大難，功宜居首。

translations.literal: When he stopped the journey to the Northern and Southern courts and summoned Tala's troops to settle the great crisis, his merit should rank first.
translations.idiomatic: When he stopped the journey to the Northern and Southern courts and summoned Tala's troops to settle the great crisis, his merit should rank first.

sentences.zh: 良以反謀白太后，韓家奴以逆順降奚人，德與阿思殺涅魯古，皆有討賊之力焉。

translations.literal: Liang reported the rebellion plot to the Empress Dowager, Hanjianu by right and wrong made the Xi men submit, De and Asi killed Nielugu—all had strength in suppressing the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Liang reported the rebellion plot to the Empress Dowager, Hanjianu by right and wrong made the Xi men submit, De and Asi killed Nielugu—all had strength in suppressing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 仁先齊名休哥，勛德兼備，此其一節歟！

translations.literal: Renxian was equal in fame to Xiuge, with merit and virtue both complete—is this not one proof of it!
translations.idiomatic: Renxian was equal in fame to Xiuge, with merit and virtue both complete—is this not one proof of it!
